name: Half-Orc
summary: Strong, fierce and hard to put down. Half-orcs carry orcish strength and fury, and many prove themselves by sheer will in a world that judges them quickly.

age.summary: Half-orcs mature a little faster than humans and rarely live past 75.

alignment.summary: Half-orcs lean toward chaos and are not strongly drawn to good.

size.description: Half-orcs are bigger and bulkier than humans, 5 to over 6 feet tall.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Menacing
features.summary: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.summary: When you drop to 0 hit points but aren't killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Once per long rest.

action.short: Drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.summary: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one of the weapon's damage dice one more time and add it.
